result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: one major layout problem with truncated restaurant name text and two minor clipping/cutoff concerns in scrollable sections.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the name 'Trattoria Piccol' — the text is hard-cut mid-word without an ellipsis, making the name unreadable and unprofessional.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent) to truncate overflowing restaurant names gracefully, or increase the card width to accommodate the full name.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is awkwardly clipped — both the image and the text below it are cut off at the screen edge without a clear visual affordance indicating scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the peek of the third card is intentional and consistent (e.g., show exactly 50% of the card) to clearly signal horizontal scrolling to the user.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card (with the -20% badge) is cut off abruptly at the screen bottom, with no gradient fade or visual cue indicating more content below.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade at the bottom of the list or ensure the card peek is consistent to better communicate vertical scrollability.
